top_categories.workout_context: 7,700ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
97ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Boone Gran Fondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
At Boone Gran Fondo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Road-specific control matters at Boone Gran Fondo. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 79 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Boone Gran Fondo. Train it until it feels boring.
79 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
7,700ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Base fitness for Boone Gran Fondo. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Boone Gran Fondo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Low-cadence force work supports 7,700ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.

race_overlay.weather: August in Boone, North Carolina, USA. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Boone Gran Fondo. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Boone Gran Fondo's 79 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Boone Gran Fondo includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Boone Gran Fondo rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 79 miles of mixed terrain in Boone, North Carolina, USA.
